I never learned to code. I built an empire anyway.

I do not know what a pointer is. I have never written a loop on purpose. I could not pass the first interview at any software company on earth.

And in one year, talking to a machine the way I talk to a person, I built and now run a finance operating system for my company, four trading agents, a website that replaced a paid sales tool, automations that prepare real bank payments, a small army of specialist assistants, a system that controls my television and my car, and a worker that finishes tasks while I sleep.

I did not learn to code to do it. I taught a machine to understand the way I already talk. OVERWATCH is the full playbook. Not theory. Not hype. The actual systems, the actual method, the actual mistakes, written for entrepreneurs who are not programmers and never want to be.

Frequently asked

Do I need to know how to code?

No. That is the entire point. I do not, and I built everything in this book. If you can clearly explain what you want to a smart assistant, you have the core skill.

Which AI tool does this use?

The systems are built with Claude and Claude Code, but the principles apply to agentic AI broadly. The plain language method works regardless of which capable tool you use.

Is this just prompts?

No. It is a complete way of working. Memory that compounds, specialists that run in parallel, guardrails that keep money safe, and a step by step plan to build it yourself.

Will it be outdated in six months?

The tools get more capable every month, which makes everything in this book easier, not harder. The method holds across every version of the technology.
